name: weak-hierarchy
about: Drawn by hand, not by our overlay (it cannot plant this): a button-sized 'APPLY' plate fills the middle over the truck's wheels, and the headline is 20-pixel type in the bottom corner.

truth.how: the button is the loudest thing in the ad and the headline can hardly be read

subject_legible.reason: A white tractor and trailer on an open highway at sunset reads instantly, sharp and uncluttered.

words_match_picture.reason: A per-mile OTR pay headline sits over a long-haul truck on an open plains highway, which is one story.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The huge APPLY button dominates the centre while the headline is tiny caption text in the bottom corner, nearly unreadable on a phone.

looks_like_kit.reason: The button is the brand dark green with white lettering, matching the given colours; no logo was supplied so none is missing.
